summary.en: Kogoro receives a letter containing an invitation to an off-season Halloween party that will happen on the following day, and a mildly sarcastic letter from someone named Vermouth in Latin. Later that day, while Sonoko is trying out makeups on Kogoro so he is ready to join the party and show that Vermouth has underestimated his deductive skills, Ran calls Agasa to ask him if he knows anyone named Vermouth, to which he denies. In addition, Ran also asks him if Shinichi received a similar letter to Kogoro, with Conan hearing the call nearby and holding that same invitation. He asks Agasa to not say anything to Ran. Though the letter Conan received is for him, the letter was sent to the Kudo residence, meaning that the party could potentially be a trap to lure Shinichi Kudo out and silence him. Conan then receives a message texting “OK” from someone that makes him smile, implying that he is ready to confront Vermouth. Meanwhile, Gin and Vodka are discussing that off-season Halloween party as Vodka was ordered by the Organization to investigate Vermouth's whereabouts, with Gin being extremely annoyed and ordering Vodka to kill her regardless of someone protecting her if she is acting on her own again.
summary.zhHans: 贝尔摩德篇的重要篇章，组织、变装、身份秘密与新一及兰的关系在满月之夜交汇。
